cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins within these bands were reduced and alkylated in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer, then enzymatically digested with trypsin at an enzyme-to-substrate ratio of 1:50 (wt:wt) at 37°C overnight.

collision_energy.evidence: followed by MS2 scans using HCD at a normalized collision energy of 28%.
